column1: # Access client operations the fork calls, and how embedded access serves each one.
# Rows are the methods referenced from compiled fork code (base, storage, backend, web) on the Access client
# interfaces, plus router calls made through a local variable. Classes follow research/access-api: critical =
# startup or every request depends on it; feature = a user-visible feature; optional = a safe default answer is
# enough; unsupported = refused by FailClosed (the caller already handles the failure).
# Checked by AccessLiteOperationsCoverageTest: critical and feature rows must be implemented, unsupported rows
# must fail closed. Method parameters are simple erased type names.
